positive.scenario: A document with a non-empty title passes.

negative.scenario: The failing fixture has no usable title and reports the rule.

inapplicable.notApplicable: The page-title rule is document-scoped and is always applicable for a full-page document scan.

exception.notApplicable: The implemented WCAG 2.4.2 page-title check has no automated authoring exception.

positive.scenario: A visible image with an accessible alternative passes.

negative.scenario: An image without an accessible alternative fails.

inapplicable.scenario: Non-image content and hidden candidates are excluded from image-name evaluation.

exception.scenario: Decorative/hidden semantics are excluded from deterministic image-name failures.

positive.scenario: A named button passes accessible-name evaluation.

negative.scenario: An unnamed button fails with accessible-name evidence.

inapplicable.scenario: Scopes without button candidates do not create button findings.

exception.scenario: An icon-only button named by a descendant SVG is accepted.

positive.scenario: A form control with a computed accessible name passes.

negative.scenario: An unnamed form control is reported by the failing fixture.

inapplicable.scenario: Non-form elements are excluded from form-control name evaluation.

exception.scenario: Placeholder fallback is not promoted to an accessible-name failure and remains a review signal.

positive.scenario: A link with discernible accessible text passes.

negative.scenario: An unnamed link is reported by the failing fixture.

inapplicable.scenario: Content without link candidates does not produce link-name findings.

exception.scenario: Link-purpose context is evaluated without inventing a deterministic failure when context remains ambiguous.

positive.scenario: Unique identifiers do not produce duplicate-id output.

negative.scenario: The legacy fixture exercises duplicate-id output retained for compatibility.

exception.scenario: Current authoring guidance emits duplicate HTML ids as warnings rather than normative WCAG failures.

positive.scenario: Visible label text contained in the accessible name passes.

negative.scenario: A visible label not represented in the accessible name fails.

inapplicable.scenario: Controls without an applicable visible text label are excluded.

exception.scenario: Normalization and symbol handling cover Label in Name matching exceptions.

positive.scenario: A document with a non-empty lang value passes the presence check.

negative.scenario: A document without html lang fails.

inapplicable.notApplicable: The primary page-language presence rule is document-scoped and always applies to a full-page scan.

exception.notApplicable: The implemented presence check has no authoring exception once a document is scanned.

positive.scenario: A known primary language subtag passes.

negative.scenario: An unknown primary language subtag fails.

inapplicable.scenario: When html lang is missing, validity is left inapplicable and FT-WCAG-008 owns the failure.

exception.scenario: Known primary subtags remain accepted when later subtags are non-standard.

positive.scenario: Text meeting the required contrast ratio passes deterministic evaluation.

negative.scenario: Low text contrast produces structured deterministic evidence.

inapplicable.scenario: Inactive or non-visible text candidates are excluded only where the standard permits it.

exception.scenario: Unresolvable gradient backgrounds are not converted into false deterministic failures.

positive.scenario: Deterministically measurable UI boundaries meeting the ratio pass.

negative.scenario: Deterministically measurable low non-text contrast fails.

inapplicable.scenario: Candidates outside the supported deterministic subset are excluded.

exception.scenario: Standard exemptions and contextual boundaries remain non-fail outcomes.

positive.scenario: Targets at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels pass the enhanced audit.

negative.scenario: Smaller measurable targets produce REVIEW, never an unsupported deterministic FAIL.

inapplicable.scenario: Candidates without measurable geometry and hidden/disabled candidates are inapplicable.

exception.scenario: Spacing, inline, equivalent-control and user-agent-control exceptions are covered.

positive.scenario: Explicit language-of-parts markup with a valid language passes.

negative.scenario: Invalid explicit language-of-parts markup fails the deterministic subset.

inapplicable.scenario: Elements without explicit language-part semantics are outside this deterministic subset.

exception.scenario: Language inheritance and excluded/non-human-language cases are handled conservatively.

positive.scenario: Named tab, tooltip and summary candidates pass.

inapplicable.scenario: Hidden and non-semantic lookalike markup is excluded.

exception.scenario: Accessible-name sources and broken-reference handling follow the shared name calculation contract.

positive.scenario: Named meter and progressbar candidates pass.

inapplicable.scenario: Hidden and non-semantic range lookalikes are excluded.

exception.scenario: Native label and ARIA naming paths are both exercised.

positive.scenario: A top-level body without aria-hidden=true passes.

negative.scenario: A top-level body with aria-hidden=true fails.

inapplicable.scenario: The page-body rule does not run for a component root.

exception.scenario: aria-hidden=false is explicitly accepted and does not behave like true.
